frame.proof: Exact profile test pixels written through the Linux DRM framebuffer and captured through the CC framebuffer observer

input.proof: All five modes passed exact Linux evdev keyboard, pointer, button and SYN packet assertions through public binary CC and emulated virtio-input

corrected_failures.problem: x86 transport rejected Linux byte writes to virtio-input configuration selectors
x86 lifecycle polling omitted input wakes from its accepted notification mask

limits: This records the completed device stages of the desktop gate. It does not itself prove Sway/WayVNC, physical devices, GUI process termination, peer guest isolation, or guest recreation.
